visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and a white t-shirt featuring a floral brand logo sits at a light-colored wooden table in a brightly lit room. He looks directly at the camera, talking with expressive facial movements and hand gestures. Behind him, a large window reveals a green vehicle parked outside. (2) A teenage girl in a pink shirt and a teenage boy in a white hoodie enter the frame from either side, placing a smartphone, a smartwatch, and wireless earphone cases onto the table in front of the man. The man looks startled and overwhelmed, while cartoonish dizzy star and spiral graphics are overlaid around his head. (3) The man gestures with his palms out to quiet the children, then leans in closer to the camera with a wide smile, holding up a small, vibrant pink rectangular device. (4) A series of close-up shots showcase two portable charging stands, one pink and one black, featuring geometric circle, triangle, and square iconography from the 'Squid Game' series. The objects are displayed on the wooden table surface alongside a pen and an earphone case. (5) The man holds the pink device, demonstrating its folding mechanism and pointing out detailed character silhouettes and text printed on the side panels. He then folds the device into a compact square and slides it easily into his brown trouser pocket to show portability. (6) The black charging stand is shown unfolding into three distinct magnetic surfaces, with an iPhone, AirPods, and an Apple Watch placed on them simultaneously to demonstrate multi-device charging capability. (7) The man holds a small black fabric pouch with white 'Squid Game' symbols while talking enthusiastically. The two chargers are neatly arranged on the table in front of him. (8) The children return to the scene; the man holds both chargers out as if showing them off, but the girl and boy quickly snatch them and exit the frame, leaving the man with a surprised and defeated expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a primary male speaker delivering a fast-paced, high-arousal monologue in Mandarin Chinese. The environment is quiet with a high signal-to-noise ratio. Occasional mid-frequency thuds and percussive clacks are heard as multiple small electronic devices are placed on a wooden surface. (2) A transition is marked by the voices of a boy and girl entering the mix, speaking with high-pitched, pleading inflections. A stylized 'whoosh' sound effect occurs, followed by the introduction of an upbeat electronic pop background music track featuring a prominent synthesizer melody and a steady 4/4 drum beat. (3) The man's vocal intensity remains high as he begins a structured product pitch. A 'ding' sound effect coincides with a visual highlight on the screen. The BGM maintains a constant volume bed underneath his clear, well-enunciated speech. (4) Frequent mechanical clicking and plastic-on-wood impacts are heard, meticulously timed with the folding and unfolding of the product. The man's tone is friendly and professional, with rising intonations used to highlight specific technical features. (5) In the final phase, the children's voices return with a playful, comedic tone. Rapid, low-frequency thumping sounds simulate running footsteps, followed by the man's surprised vocal exclamation. The music track gradually fades out alongside the dying chatter of the children.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous family sketch to introduce and promote a 3-in-1 magnetic foldable charging stand. By showing the 'problem' of multiple family members needing to charge devices, it positions the product as a convenient and portable solution, highlighting its 'Squid Game' collaboration design to appeal to fans of the series.
